title: EventsSubscriptionResult
description: events.subscription-result@1: answers of the subscription routes on OpenVibe.Events. POST /api/v1/subscriptions → 201 events.subscription@1 with its secret (shown once); GET /api/v1/subscriptions → { subscriptions } (the caller's own, no secrets); GET /api/v1/subscriptions/:id and POST …/disable|enable → events.subscription@1. Another consumer's subscription is 404.
